title: Mandala Bold and Easy: Coloring Book for Adults

cover_prompt: Full-color illustration, warm inviting zen aesthetic, premium coloring book cover artwork. A large beautiful mandala design in the center featuring flowing floral petals, gentle curves, and layered symmetrical patterns. The mandala glows with rich jewel tones of teal, gold, coral, deep purple, and warm amber against a soft gradient background transitioning from deep navy to warm indigo. Delicate golden sparkle accents scattered around the mandala. The design is bold and elegant with thick flowing lines, large petal shapes, and a serene meditative quality. Ornamental corner flourishes in gold. Warm inviting atmosphere that conveys relaxation and mindfulness. NO text in the image.
